metadata.question: Does the water in the southeastern coast of Guishan Island (24.83594812988359, 121.96499287870442) exhibit a lighter blue coloration than the northwestern coastal waters (24.84607374884142, 121.93452298429524) on September 29, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Two points around Guishan Island (Taiwan) - southeastern coast (24.836, 121.965) and northwestern coast (24.846, 121.935) - Date: September 29, 2021 (single day, may need to expand window) - Collection: Sentinel-2 for RGB/true color analysis (better resolution than Landsat) 2. Masking strategy: - DO mask clouds since we're comparing water color/appearance - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - May need to check if pixels are water (not land) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - "Lighter blue" means higher reflectance in blue band, but overall brighter appearance - Compare brightness/luminosity: Can use blue band (B2) or combined RGB brightness - Valid result: Numeric comparison of reflectance values - C1: No images found for the date - C2: All pixels masked out (clouds or land) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Southeast is lighter than northwest - B: Southeast is NOT lighter (darker or same) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const pointSE = ee.Geometry.Point([121.96499287870442, 24.83594812988359]); const pointNW = ee.Geometry.Point([121.93452298429524, 24.84607374884142]); const targetDate = '2021-09-29'; // Create small buffer around points for sampling const regionSE = pointSE.buffer(50); const regionNW = pointNW.buffer(50); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2021-09-29', '2021-09-30') .filterBounds(pointSE.buffer(5000)); let colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Initial Sentinel-2 images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try wider date range collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2021-09-25', '2021-10-05') .filterBounds(pointSE.buffer(5000)); colSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Expanded date range images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for the location and date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Processing const image = collection.map(maskClouds).median(); // Use blue band (B2) and green band (B3) to assess water color // Lighter blue water = higher reflectance in visible bands const blueGreen = image.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); // Check pixel counts for both locations const countSE = blueGreen.select('B2').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: regionSE, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); const countNW = blueGreen.select('B2').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: regionNW, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); console.log(`SE valid pixels: ${countSE}, NW valid pixels: ${countNW}`); if (countSE === 0 || countNW === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking for one or both locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - compute average brightness (blue+green bands) const statsSE = blueGreen.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: regionSE, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsNW = blueGreen.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: regionNW, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const blueSE = statsSE.B2; const blueNW = statsNW.B2; const greenSE = statsSE.B3; const greenNW = statsNW.B3; console.log(`SE - Blue: ${blueSE}, Green: ${greenSE}`); console.log(`NW - Blue: ${blueNW}, Green: ${greenNW}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (blueSE == null || blueNW == null || greenSE == null || greenNW == null) { console.log('Calculation returned null values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(blueSE) || isNaN(blueNW)) { console.log('Calculation returned NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate overall brightness (lighter blue = higher reflectance) const brightnessSE = (blueSE + greenSE) / 2; const brightnessNW = (blueNW + greenNW) / 2; console.log(`SE brightness: ${brightnessSE.toFixed(2)}, NW brightness: ${brightnessNW.toFixed(2)}`); if (brightnessSE > brightnessNW) { console.log('Southeast coast exhibits lighter blue coloration.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Southeast coast does NOT exhibit lighter blue coloration.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
